The table image may be rotated, but the html representation must not be rotated. Include the full table, with the opening and closing table tags. Guidelines: - Reproduce the original values from the image exactly, character for character. Never guess a value. - Fix stray characters in the html that don't match the image. - Make sure column headers sit above the correct column values, and merged cells use colspan/rowspan. - Inline math goes in tags. - Only use the tags table, tr, th, td, br, span, sup, sub, i, b and math, and only the attributes colspan and rowspan. If the html is completely correct, or you cannot read the image properly, set "needs_corrections" to false and leave "corrected_html" empty. 3.
